subject: theo
title: DFA → regex
description: Eliminate the states of a DFA until a regular expression is left.
promptTemplate: Create a DFA of {{level}} difficulty (easy: 2–3 states, medium: 3–4, exam: 4 with loops) to convert into a regular expression by state elimination. Do not state the elimination order. When checking: equivalence of the result matters more than its form; check each elimination step on its own.
answerFormat: Elimination steps one after another, the regular expression at the end.
